dslRule:
<!id: use-instancescope-singleton>
<!description: Replace new InstanceScope() with InstanceScope.INSTANCE to use the singleton instance.
This is the recommended and more efficient way to access the InstanceScope since Eclipse 3.7 (Platform 3.7.0).
>
<!severity: HINT>
new org.eclipse.core.runtime.preferences.InstanceScope()
=>
org.eclipse.core.runtime.preferences.InstanceScope.INSTANCE
;;
